from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -30m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry_raw" and (r.area == "AguaIndustrial" or r.area == "AguaAlimentacion" or r.area == "AguaDesmineralizada" or r.area == "VaporSobrecalentado" or r.area == "Condensado") and r._field == "value")

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -6h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kpi" and (r.kpi == "energia_generada_mwh_h" or r.kpi == "oee" or r.kpi == "energia_por_ton_biomasa") and r._field == "value") |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -6h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "anomaly_event") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "equipment", "severity", "type", "score", "message", "probable_cause", "impacted_kpis"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -6h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "maintenance_recommendation") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "equipment", "severity", "probable_cause", "suggested_action", "due_minutes", "expected_impact", "ack_status"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
